target: Testudo graeca / Mediterranean Testudo; Ibera direct evidence remains limited
not_decision: not proof all Korean plants called 민들레 are T. officinale
rationale: British Chelonia Group Mediterranean tortoise care explicitly lists dandelion among garden forage foods.
BCG nutritional guidance describes wild Testudo vegetation as high-fibre/high-calcium and low-fat/protein and recommends varied weeds/flowers/grasses rather than reliance on few foods.
USDA official SR Legacy record for raw T. officinale leaves supplies traceable nutrient composition including Ca 187 mg and P 66 mg per 100 g (Ca:P 2.83).
Botanical identity and collection contamination remain separate safety gates.
editorial_rule: Recommend within a varied leafy/weed diet; do not assign an evidence-free exact percentage or daily gram dose.
